messages.author: 62df6b9d8121ed48
messages.subject: all ports are allocated error message
parts:
Tried to deploy a shiny app to shiny.ios by got this error message: 

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 413470 error: Unhandled Exception: Cannot start container 55e42e503d7b9e53b1167759b521769d30d74f82f884d6246b6c8a8b1831b23b: all ports are allocated

What is it?

messages.author: 686ab6dc2c630995
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] all ports are allocated error message

Hi Sam,
We ran into a problem yesterday where we ran out of ports on a couple servers. We applied a short term fix to get everything up and running. Long term fixes still need to be worked out. Thanks for letting us know.
